data.description:
# Selection list not refreshed after x-c/x-d shortcuts

Keyboard shortcuts that modify work items (close, delete, update) do not immediately refresh the selection list, leaving stale data visible.

## Current Behavior

The `x-c` (close) and `x-d` (delete) chord shortcuts execute their commands but do not trigger a list refresh. The selection list continues to show the closed/deleted item until the next auto-refresh cycle (30s) or manual refresh (r).

This also affects other commands that modify work items:
- `u-p-*` (priority updates)
- `u-s` (stage/status updates)
- `u-t` (title updates)
- `a-y` (audit approve)
- `a-r` (audit reject)
- `s` (search)
- `r` (Producer Review toggle)
- `d` (downtime toggle)

## Root Cause

The `isWlViewCommand()` function in `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` (line ~4192) only matches `/wl` filter commands (`/wl`, `/wl <stage>`, `/wl --priority <level>`). Commands starting with `!!wl close/delete/update/reviewed` are not matched, so `doRefresh(true)` is never called for them.

```typescript
const isWlViewCommand = (cmd: string): boolean => {
  if (/^\/wl\s*$/.test(cmd)) return true;
  const stageMatch = cmd.match(/^\/wl\s+(\S+)$/);
  if (stageMatch !== null && STAGE_MAP[stageMatch[1]] !== undefined) return true;
  const priorityMatch = cmd.match(/^\/wl\s+--priority\s+(\S+)$/);
  return priorityMatch !== null && PRIORITY_MAP[priorityMatch[1]] !== undefined;
};
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `x-c` (close) immediately refreshes the selection list
- [ ] `x-d` (delete) immediately refreshes the selection list
- [ ] All shortcut commands that modify work items trigger an immediate list refresh
- [ ] List refresh does not interfere with already-removed items (graceful handling)
- [ ] All existing tests pass
data.title: Fix shortcut commands not refreshing selection list

data.comment: Fix committed to dev: ebf57e59 — routes data-modifying `!!wl close|delete|update|search` commands through dispatchChordCommand so executeResolvedCommand returns 'dispatched' and the caller's isWlModifyingCommand check triggers an immediate list refresh. Previously these commands fell through to the generic callback path ('callback'), so the refresh check never fired. Full suite: 5525 passed / 5 skipped. Build: OK.
